# Tokenizart

> Tokenizart is infrastructure for creating and preserving verifiable digital identity, evidence and traceability for artworks and other unique physical objects.

## Where the product is used

- [Atelier](https://atelier.tokenizart.com/): Tokenizart's operating platform. Authenticated users prepare artwork or object records, review information and perform the actions enabled for their account.
- [Tokenizart website](https://tokenizart.com/): public identity, services, knowledge and access to the ecosystem.
- [Shop](https://tokenizart.com/shop/): public entry point for available Tokenizart products and vouchers.
- [Companion public beta](https://companion-staging.tokenizart.info/beta): public educational assistant in staging; it does not read an Atelier account or execute actions.
- [Demo Atelier](https://companion-staging.tokenizart.info/demo-atelier): synthetic practice environment; it does not use real wallets, vouchers, blockchain or owner data.

## Core concepts

- Tokenizart uses ERC-721 to represent the unique digital identity associated with an artwork or unique object.
- Mint creates the initial token record and consumes the applicable Mint voucher.
- Certify adds an attributed event or evidence to the object's history. It does not create another NFT or transfer ownership.
- NFC and VOID elements can support a physical-digital link, with limits that must be explained for each use case.
- Atelier simplifies blockchain interaction through smart-wallet and account-abstraction infrastructure. Users do not need to operate gas manually in native supported flows.
- Public Gallery information is limited to what the owner chooses to expose.

## Important limits

- Tokenization does not automatically transfer copyright, image rights, intellectual property, physical possession or contractual rights.
- Tokenizart organizes attributable evidence and traceability; it does not guarantee authenticity, price, liquidity or legal outcome.
- Release-candidate CLI, MCP, skills and OKF artifacts are documented separately and are not production endpoints on this domain.
- Owner Live is private, authenticated and consent-scoped. It is not a public crawler resource.

## Agentic readiness and methodology

Tokenizart uses [Agent Friendly Web](https://agentfriendlyweb.dev/casos/tokenizart) to document and verify its progressive agent-first roadmap. This public case separates observed evidence from planned capabilities. It is not an official certification and does not grant account permissions.
